result.description: The Orchid Vale Aster is a fictional 27-inch reference monitor designed for color-critical studio environments, with a matte panel, wide viewing angles, and a built-in hood for controlled lighting. It targets editors, illustrators, and prepress workflows rather than gaming or general office use. Key features include 2560 x 1440 resolution, 10-bit color support, factory calibration, DisplayPort and USB-C inputs, and a sturdy adjustable stand for long production sessions.
